title: Naxos course source integration
details: Naxos Mapping Engine is the source of the learner course structure when a Naxos course is imported
The Evia avatar follows the exact Naxos 5 × 5 × 5 category, subcategory and task structure
The Course arch keeps Evia’s official KSB or AC view with yellow, purple, blue and orange evidence-source ticks
Evia evidence, RPL, Milos observations, Tinos witness evidence, progress and completion use the same imported course state
Naxos facet and atomic assessment-criterion requirements are preserved for completion
summary: Evia v242 uses Naxos as the imported course-definition source while preserving Evia’s existing learner, evidence and Course coverage systems.
